name: _switch.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  preferences/_switch.scss — iOS-style toggle switch rows (pref-switch) — label left, pill right, checked states.
//  Imported by preferences.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ─── Toggle Switch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Single row with label on left, iOS-style switch pill on right.
// Replaces 2-button pattern for binary on/off toggles.

$_B_SW: 'pref-switch';
$_SW_W: 52; // switch pill width
$_SW_H: 28; // switch pill height
$_SW_KNOB: 22; // knob diameter
$_SW_PAD: 3; // padding inside pill

// One switch row (label + description + WebGL toggle).
.#{$_B_SW}-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) 0;
  border-bottom: to-rem(1) solid var(--border-color);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;

  &:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}

// Text side of a switch row.
.#{$_B_SW}-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

// Switch row label.
.#{$_B_SW}-label {
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: to-rem(15);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

// Switch row description.
.#{$_B_SW}-desc {
  font-size: to-rem(13);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

// The WebGL switch canvas (pill track + knob).
.#{$_B_SW} {
  // The pill track
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: to-rem($_SW_W);
  height: to-rem($_SW_H);
  background: var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  overflow: hidden;

  &-canvas {
    width: to-rem($_SW_W);
    height: to-rem($_SW_H);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    display: block;
    pointer-events: none;

    &.is-fallback {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  &:has(.#{$_B_SW}-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])) {
    background: transparent;
  }

  // Fallback CSS knob when canvas has is-fallback class
  &:has(.#{$_B_SW}-canvas.is-fallback) {
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: to-rem($_SW_PAD);
      left: to-rem($_SW_PAD);
      width: to-rem($_SW_KNOB);
      height: to-rem($_SW_KNOB);
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--color-white-raw);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition:
        transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
        background 0.2s ease;
    }

    &.#{$_B_SW}--on::after {
      transform: translateX(to-rem($_SW_W - $_SW_KNOB - $_SW_PAD * 2));
      background: var(--bg-darkest);
    }
  }

  // ON state
  &--on {
    background: var(--color-accent);
  }
}
